text: The world needs more physicians like Dr. Kittipan. He was very thorough in explaining the condition of my varicose vein and the laser treatment that would follow.  During the procedure he  explained what he was doing and warned me of any pain that might occur.  However, there was almost no pain and I felt totally confident in him. I had the procedure at Sriphat Hospital because of my age, and the nurses were wonderful.  Dr.Kittipan took the time to send me a text message that night checking to see if I was okay.  I  am so glad that had the procedure after delaying it for several years.  I recommend him as a superb physician and a most kind human being.

I can't rate Dr. Kittipan's clinic highly enough. From the first visit the entire staff was extremely supportive and made sure I always received the best care.

As for the treatment, I had EVLA therapy to remove varicose veins in both legs one month ago. The surgery was done very professionally and up to western standards. Both legs have healed perfectly since then and feel much better.

Having previously had the same procedure done in Germany I can say the standard in this clinic is on the same level, if not better.

Thank you to Dr. Kittipan and the whole team!

The doctor provided detailed advice and explained the treatment plan, caring for me from the time of the vascular surgery until I fully recovered. The medical team is highly skilled, and the clinic is equipped with modern equipment. The clinic is clean, spacious, and not crowded.
The place was clean, and the doctor gave excellent advice before treatment. After treatment, the doctor also followed up. Overall, I was very impressed.

I have had varicose veins and leg pain for 3-4 years, and the pain has been severe for about a month. I wanted to see Dr. Kittiphan for treatment. I started by researching and asking friends from Chiang Mai, and then contacted Dr. Kittiphan via Line to plan my trip. I received excellent responses, saving me travel time. I was able to check before leaving whether Dr. Kittiphan's clinic was open that day. I arrived at 5:15 PM. The housekeeper suggested I have something to eat first. The nurse arrived at 5:30 PM, and Dr. Kittiphan arrived at 6:30 PM.
This allowed me to plan everything. Upon examination, Dr. Kittiphan, with his high level of expertise, found an abnormality and scheduled surgery for the next day. He explained the treatment plan, including laser and radiofrequency treatments, including saline and cooling treatments, and inquired about my insurance coverage. We decided to have surgery at the Sri Phaphat Building. The surgery didn't take long; I was able to get out of bed and practice walking in the recovery room soon after. There was no pain or swelling. No pain, no swelling, no bruising. Dr. Kittiphan explained how to behave and basic first aid if any abnormalities occurred. The treatment exceeded expectations because there was no pain at all. I rested overnight without any pain or wounds. The room was comfortable and clean.
The next day, the doctor visited, and I was able to go home and have a follow-up appointment in one week.
The doctor also recommended that I bring my mother for a check-up. I was very impressed. The doctor provided close care, explained things thoroughly, and gave excellent advice. This treatment felt like receiving care from a family member, truly cared for with all their heart. Thank you to all the team members, and my deepest gratitude to Dr. Kittiphan. The pain is gone, the swelling in my leg has significantly decreased, and I can walk normally now!

The doctor gave me excellent advice. I was very impressed.
The service was excellent...

This is a specialized clinic for varicose vein treatment. I took my mother there, and the doctor was very helpful. The first visit might involve a fee for X-rays to check for varicose veins, after which the doctor will propose treatment options and give us time to decide. You can ask questions via LINE if you have any doubts. My mother's treatment plan involves laser therapy, which the doctor will schedule after we agree to proceed. The laser treatment on her legs took about an hour, but afterwards she was able to walk and live normally. It was amazing! After the laser treatment, the doctor scheduled a follow-up appointment to check her veins again. The clinic is clean, the doctor is kind, and the staff are very helpful. It was worth the money spent; my mother's varicose veins are gone, so it's a success!
